purpose: What each flow in the tenant runs, by the fingerprint of the identification package pasted into it (scripts/lib/package-fingerprint.mjs). A package needs pasting only when it has no entry; it needs pasting again only when its fingerprint differs from its entry. Maintained by hand from evidence: an owner report (the package as published when the report was made) or a tenant export (the fingerprint of the exported scope, which the Folio Estate Console computes when the export is dropped into it). A fingerprint of null records a flow that runs a definition no package produced.
